Subject: Cobalt - quick call recap + next steps (pricing & commitment)

Hi Anna / Tom,

Thanks again for the time this morning — great discussion. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (from the demo & discovery)
- Primary workload: real-time summarization + entity extraction for customer support tickets (latency sensitive).
- Initial footprint estimate: ~50M tokens/month first 3 months, scaling to ~200M tokens/month by month 12 with burst days.
- Target unit economics: your team mentioned wanting to be around $700 per 1M tokens (effective price) as a goal to hit product unit costs.
- Procurement timeline: target signing by mid-December; PO issued by Cobalt finance the week after signature.

Questions / asks (what we need from you)
1) Please confirm the initial run-rate (50M/mo) and the 12-month ramp to 200M/mo — any seasonal spikes we should know about?
2) Confirm whether budget range of $8k–$20k/month is just the first quarter or a sustained monthly budget envelope.
3) If you want to pursue the Startup Program discount + committed-use path, please confirm internal approvers (CFO contact) so we can tailor the MAP.

What we (Redwood) will do next
- Share a tailored offer showing two paths: Startup program (introductory credit + fixed discount for first 6 months) and a committed-use 12/24-month pricing schedule with tiered unit economics.
- Attach a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a simple committed-use discount table for internal review.
- If it looks good, we’ll prepare a DocuSign offer and run legal procurement support in-parallel.

Attachments: Cobalt_MAP_v1.pdf (draft MAP)

Would you be available for a 20–30 minute call Thursday to walk the offer and align on the PO/contract owner?

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the clear notes. Confirming the numbers from our side: 

- Initial confirmed: 50M tokens/month for months 1–3 (supporting pilot).
- Expected ramp: we expect a steady growth profile to ~120M by month 6 and ~200M by month 12, driven by two product launches (mid Q2 and late Q3). We have a few customers in pilot that will increase burst traffic (estimated +30% on certain days).
- Budget: the $8k–$20k figure was internal for the pilot and early product-market fit stage; realistic committed budget for production is closer to $18k–$28k/month once we sign a 12-month contract.
- Target unit price: we’d like to see an effective price around $700 / 1M tokens after discounts (that’s what keeps our unit economics intact).

Procurement:
- Our CFO (Michael Yuen, cfo@cobaltanalytics.com) will own contract/PO approval. We need a standard SOW + invoice-ready pricing table.
- Timeline: aim for signature by Dec 16; PO expected within 3 business days post-signature.

We are very interested in a combined approach: startup program to accelerate the pilot, then a committed-use tier for 12–24 months. Please send the two-path offer and highlight how overages are priced.

Thanks — looping Michael and Tom on next steps.

Best,

Stephanie / Marissa —

Thanks for the thread. Quick internal thoughts so we can move to an offer:

1) Startup Program (pilot-first):
- Proposal: one-time credit equivalent to 35% off list hosted price for the first 6 months (applied as monthly credits to invoices).
- Eligibility: requires company <24 months revenue or qualifying seed stage (Cobalt qualifies on founder/metric call).
- Goal: reduce friction for pilot, align with their $8k–$20k early envelope.

2) Committed-Use (12-mo):
- Proposal: tiered committed discount: 0–50M = 15% off list, 50–150M = 22% off list, 150M+ = 30% off list, applied to committed tokens.
- Overages billed at list price, with monthly true-up against committed baseline. We can provide an annualized blended $/1M metric in the offer.

3) Multi-year incentive (24-mo):
- Proposal: 24-mo commit gets an additional 5% absolute on top of committed discounts + one-time onboarding credit (equivalent to 75k tokens).

Preliminary price math (very rough)
- List hosted price: $1,000 / 1M tokens (example bucket for modeling).
- With 12-mo commit and ramp to 200M, blended effective price could land between $650–$820 / 1M depending on upfront commitment level and startup credit application.

Next steps (internal)
- Stephanie: prepare the two-path offer (Startup+Pilot vs 12/24-mo CU) with a one-page comparison table and a simple MAP.
- Marissa: include legal procurement language (SOW template + invoice-ready table).
- I’ll attach a compressed committed-use discount table for the quote.

Attachment: CU_discount_table.xlsx

Rishi
